k:HH.Ins.Slogan.1: Clawback Mutual. We've got you covered.*  (*see clauses 1 to infinity)
k:HH.Ins.Slogan.4: We're there when you need us. Office hours apply.
k:HH.Ins.Slogan.5: Every limb has a price. We wrote it down.
k:HH.Ins.Slogan.6: Your claim is important to us. Please hold.
k:HH.Ins.Slogan.7: Comprehensive cover, comprehensively explained in 400 pages.
k:HH.Ins.Slogan.8: Most colonies choose Premium. Most colonies are still waiting.
k:HH.Ins.Sign.Off: Clawback Mutual is not open for business in this game.
k:HH.Ins.Sign.TooOld: This colonist is already of pension age. A pension cannot be bought at pension age; that is what the plan is for.
k:HH.Ins.Sign.Duplicate: You already hold this policy. We checked twice.
k:HH.Ins.Sign.Debt: No new policies until you have settled the {0} we are owed from clause 22.
k:HH.Ins.Sign.NoMap: We could not find your colony. This is unusual.
k:HH.Ins.Sign.Threat: Clawback Mutual does not sign cover while a threat, a raid or a large fire is on. We would hate to be unfair to ourselves.
k:HH.Ins.Sign.CannotPay: The first instalment of {0} could not be debited. Even we cannot insure an empty purse.
k:HH.Ins.Locked.Actuarial: Needs the research project Actuarial Science
k:HH.Ins.Log.Regrowth: Claim #{0}: a part grew back, {1} claimed back.
k:HH.Ins.End.Holder: the insured person is no longer with us
k:HH.Ins.Clause.Exclusion: This is an exclusion, not a decision. We merely read it out.
k:HH.Ins.Bd.PreExisting: Deducted: {0} % that was there when you signed (clause 9).
k:HH.Ins.Bd.PartialNotPaid: Partial losses are not paid at Bare Minimum.
k:HH.Ins.Bd.BelowThreshold: The grade is below the threshold of {0} % for your tier. Benefit: 0 silver. Congratulations.
k:HH.Ins.Bd.Progression: {0}: progression gives {1} of the basic sum of {2}. Benefit before the fine print: {3}.
k:HH.Ins.Bd.Contributed: An old ailment on the same part cuts the benefit by 25 % (clause 9, from Overbooked).
k:HH.Ins.Bd.DeathAssess: Claim #{0} ended with the death (clause 23): the higher of both is paid.
k:HH.Ins.Bd.UnderInsured: Under-insured: sum {0} against a value of {1}. We pay {2} of it, proudly.
k:HH.Ins.Bd.Kulanz: Goodwill gesture (once a year, Premium only). Do not get used to it.
k:HH.Ins.Bd.Legal: Legal Shield made us less enthusiastic about denying this.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Title: Welcome to Clawback Mutual: {0}
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Body:
Dear policyholder,

thank you for choosing {0} at {1}. Your premium of {2} will be debited automatically every {3} days. You need to do nothing, ever, which is the idea.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Waiting: Cover begins after a waiting period of {0} days. The waiting period begins when cover begins. Please see clause 1.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Riders: To save you time, these add-ons were included for you: {0}. You can remove them in the desk whenever you like, in principle.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Paid: The first instalment was debited from {0}.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Title: Claim #{0} received
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Body: We have received your claim #{0} ({1}) under {2}. It is important to us. Our Claims Department will look at it in one to three days, depending on how it looks back.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Death: We are sorry for your loss. Claim ({0}) has been received and will be handled with care.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Assessment: Accident cover is assessed {0} after the accident, when the damage has settled. Preview of the benefit today: {1}.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Waiting: Please note that the event happened during the waiting period. We say this kindly.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.Approved: Good news. Your claim is approved: {0}.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.Partial: Your claim is partly approved: {0} of {1}. We are very proud of the part we approved.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.Denied: After careful consideration, which took some time, your claim is denied.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.CanNegotiate: You may negotiate within ten days; our door is open, in a manner of speaking.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.PayLater: Payment follows in {0}. Processing times are not a promise, they are a hope.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.InKind: You may also take building materials by capsule instead of silver (open the desk).
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Paid.Title: Claim #{0}: paid
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Paid.Body: Claim #{0} has been paid: {1}, {2}. Thank you for being a customer. We will remember it at your next premium.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Paid.Neutral: The benefit of {0} has been paid, {1}. We wish you strength.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Ended.Title: {0}: ended
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Ended.Debt: A claw-back of {0} (clause 22) remains open. New policies need it settled first.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Missed.Title: {0}: premium not received
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Missed.Body: We could not debit {1} for {0}. A friendly reminder: we will try again tomorrow, and the day after. Then we will stop being friendly.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Lapsed.Title: {0}: lapsed
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Lapsed.Body: Your policy {0} has lapsed after three missed instalments ({1} each). Your cover ended, which is a sad thing for us to write and an efficient thing to bill.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Premium.Title: {0}: premium adjusted
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Premium.Body: Your premium for {0} was adjusted from {1} to {2} per quadrum to reflect your circumstances. For five days you may cancel it at once, which we mention because the law makes us.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Title: {0}: a part grew back
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Body: We were pleased to learn that a part of {0} has grown back. We claim back {1}. {2} {3}
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Offset: It will be offset against future benefits.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Debt: It is open as a debt; no new policies until it is settled.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Renew.Title: {0}: renewal notice
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Renew.Body: Your policy {0} renews in three days. {1}
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Retro.Title: Bundle discount recalculated
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Retro.Body: Because you left, the bundle discount of the running quadrum was recalculated. We debited {0}. It is on the last page.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Uncovered.Title: You could have been covered.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Uncovered.Body: We noticed the loss of {0}. It was not insured. {1} would have been happy to help. It still is, for a premium.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Title: Your Clawback year
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Intro: A year with Clawback Mutual: {0} in premiums over {1} active policies. Here is what our sales tricks cost you.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Total: Together: {0}, which is {1} of your yearly premiums (cap: {2}).
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Credit: Courtesy credit: {0} paid back to you, {1}.
k:HH.Ins.Letter.Year.NoCredit: Everything is within the cap. We call that fair.
k:HH.Ins.Upsell.Title: Clawback Mutual suggests
k:HH.Ins.Upsell.Body: Your {0} at {1} is lovely. Most colonies choose Premium.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.Title: Negotiating claim #{0}
k:HH.Ins.Neg.Lead: {0}. Offer now: {1} (claim value {2}). Up to three rounds. Choose the tone.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.NoNegotiator: Nobody in the colony can talk right now.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.Approach.Quote: Quote the contract back at them
k:HH.Ins.Neg.HintQuote: Works best against a clause that is open to interpretation. Hopeless against an exclusion.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.HintLawyers: Legal Shield is on your side. Brix & Partners adore a dispute.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.HintNoLawyers: You have no Legal Shield; they will notice.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.Success: They gave in. Possibly a first. The full benefit is yours: {0}.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.Partial: After some sighing they offer {0} ({1} of the benefit). Take it or try again.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.Fail: The Claims Department thanks you for your input and keeps its decision.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.NotPossible: This claim cannot be negotiated any more.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.Cancelled: As you were rude about the clauses, Clawback Mutual has decided to part ways with you. The policy is cancelled.
k:HH.Ins.Neg.Free: On this difficulty, negotiating never costs you anything.
